newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African exporters envisage greater foreign sales.
newsitem.headline: S.African exporters envisage greater foreign sales.

text.p: South African exporters are overwhelmingly optimistic for increased foreign sales in U.S. dollar terms this year, survey results showed on Tuesday.

The South African Foreign Trade Organisation (Safto) said its Export Confidence Survey found 72 percent of the country's large and medium-sized businesses were optimistic of improved sales, particuarly in the first quarter.
An even higher percentage, 79 percent, of small companies were expecting better export sales.
Inhibiting factors had however varied little in the past year, the export marketing consultants cautioned.
"Uncompetitive prices and the cost and availability of transport still appear at the top of the list," Safto said in a statement outlining the survey findings.
Questionnaires were issued to Safto's membership of around 800 companies.
